description: This file defines the DistributedSub interface, which provides an API for managing pub-sub subscriptions in a distributed environment within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, declaring acknowledgement labels, and creating instances with configuration.

classes.name: DistributedSub
classes.description: Interface providing methods for managing pub-sub subscriptions and acknowledgements in a distributed system.

methods.name: subscribeWithFilterAndAck
methods.description: Subscribes to a collection of topics with a local filter and acknowledgment, returning a future completion.

methods.name: subscribeWithAck
methods.description: Subscribes to topics with acknowledgment, returning a future completion.

methods.name: unsubscribeWithAck
methods.description: Unsubscribes from topics with acknowledgment, returning a future completion.

methods.name: subscribeWithoutAck
methods.description: Subscribes to topics without waiting for acknowledgment.

methods.name: unsubscribeWithoutAck
methods.description: Unsubscribes from topics without waiting for acknowledgment.

methods.name: declareAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Declares acknowledgment labels for a subscriber, returning a future of acknowledgment.

methods.name: removeAcknowledgementLabelDeclaration
methods.description: Removes acknowledgment label declarations for a subscriber.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DistributedSub instance from configuration and a sub-supervisor ActorRef.
